# Accessibility (AP-A11Y)

[Back to catalog](index.md)

## AP-A11Y-01

**Icon-only button without accessible name** — severity **major**, automated (scanner), principles P-09.

**Why it hurts.** Screen readers announce an unlabeled button as "button".

**Fix.** Add Text, or title plus aria-label.

**Bad:**

```razor
<RadzenButton Icon="delete" Click="@Delete" />
```

**Good:**

```razor
<RadzenButton Icon="delete" title="Delete customer" aria-label="Delete customer" Click="@Delete" />
```

**Verify with MCP:** `Radzen Blazor RadzenButton accessibility aria-label icon only`

**Detection:** files `*.razor`; pattern `<RadzenButton\b(?=[^>]*\bIcon\s*=)(?![^>]*\b(Text|title|aria-label|AriaLabel)\s*=)[^>]*/>`.

## AP-A11Y-02

**Colour as the only signal** — severity **minor**, manual review (G7), principles P-09.

**Why it hurts.** Status shown only by colour is invisible to colour-blind users.

**Fix.** Add text or an icon with a label.

## AP-A11Y-03

**Image without alt text** — severity **minor**, automated (scanner), principles P-09.

**Why it hurts.** Images without alt are announced by file name or skipped without context.

**Fix.** Add alt (empty alt="" for decorative images).

**Detection:** files `*.razor`, `*.cshtml`, `*.html`; pattern `<img\b(?![^>]*\balt\s*=)[^>]*>`.

## AP-A11Y-04

**Input without label** — severity **major**, manual review (G7), principles P-09.

**Why it hurts.** Inputs need a programmatic label (RadzenFormField Text, RadzenLabel Component, or aria-label).

**Fix.** Wrap inputs in RadzenFormField or associate a RadzenLabel.

## AP-A11Y-05

**Positive tabindex** — severity **minor**, automated (scanner), principles P-09.

**Why it hurts.** Positive tabindex breaks the natural focus order.

**Fix.** Use DOM order; tabindex 0 or -1 only.

**Detection:** files `*.razor`, `*.html`; pattern `tabindex\s*=\s*"?[1-9]`.
